senses.gloss:
वैलक्षण्य n. (-ण्यं) Difference, contrariety.
 E. विलक्षण, and ष्यञ् aff.

वैलक्ष्य n. (-क्ष्यं)
 1. Contrariety, reverse, inversion.
 2. Contrary course
or conduct to that which is usual or natural.
 3. Absence of any
characteristic.
 4. Shame.
 5. Sorrow.
 E. विलक्ष, and ष्यञ् aff.

वैल्व mfn. (-ल्वः-ल्वी-ल्वं) Relating or belonging to the Vilwa-tree.
 n. (-ल्वं)
The fruit of the Vilwa, (Ægle marmelos.)
 E. विल्व the tree, अण् aff.

वैल्वमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of the Vilwa, of the wood, &c. of that
tree.
 E. वैल्व relating to the Bel, and मयट् aff.
